meta.title: System status | Youssef El Hadraoui
meta.description: System status of yel-hadr.github.io: uptime and latency checks, CI/CD pipeline health and 7 days of history.

title: System status
lead: Live health of this site, the services it depends on and its CI/CD pipelines. A GitHub Actions workflow checks everything about every 30 minutes and publishes the results as static JSON; the time of the last check is shown below.

overall.label: Overall status
overall.stale: This data is more than 2 hours old, so the monitor may have stopped running. The status above is the last one it published.
overall.remote: Showing the data published on yel-hadr.github.io.
overall.noData: The status monitor has not published any results yet. It runs in GitHub Actions, about every 30 minutes. Until then, the CI/CD pipelines below are read live from the GitHub API, and no service is reported as up without a check.
overall.pipelineUnknown: {name}: the status could not be read

monitors.title: Services
monitors.lead: HTTP checks sent from GitHub Actions runners. A failed check is retried once before it counts as down.
monitors.historyMissing: The latest monitor run could not read the earlier checks, so uptime and response-time percentiles are left blank until the next run.
monitors.sparkLabel: Response time over the last 24 hours: {count} checks, median {median}, slowest {max}, {failed} failed.
monitors.sparkEmpty: Not enough data for a trend yet.

pipelines.title: CI/CD pipelines
pipelines.lead: Latest GitHub Actions runs of the pipelines that build and deploy this site, and of a project repository.
pipelines.live: Read live from the GitHub API.
pipelines.notCounted: Does not affect the overall status
pipelines.unavailable: This pipeline could not be read.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.ownNote: Drawn from the monitor’s own 7-day history. A Grafana dashboard can be connected to replace these charts.
metrics.grafanaNote: The dashboard below is served by Grafana.
metrics.chartLabel: Line chart of the {name} response time over the last 7 days: {count} checks, median {median}, 95th percentile {p95}, {failed} failed.
metrics.chartEmpty: No successful check of this service in the last 7 days.
metrics.tableToggle: Show the data as a table
metrics.uptimeCaption: Share of successful checks per service and day. A dash means no check that day.
metrics.noHistory: No history yet: the charts appear after the first monitor runs.
metrics.historyFailed: The history could not be loaded.

api.title: JSON endpoint
api.body: The same data is public JSON, updated after every check, about every 30 minutes (GitHub Pages allows cross-origin reads).
api.summary: Summary: overall status, services and pipelines
